purpose: Fix the production-proven Gekta starter progressive-disclosure defect where a Tailwind display utility overrides the hidden attribute, causing all starter cards to remain exposed before expansion; strengthen production acceptance to verify exactly three visible starters before disclosure and more after expansion.
forbiddenChanges: model runtime, prompt, inference routing or latency experiments
agro-chat API or attachment backend contracts
PC-CROP registration, reviewer, MFA or password-reset runtime
role, tenant, RBAC, RLS or PostgreSQL authority
production credentials or direct REG.RU mutation
paid external services or new infrastructure
maturityBoundary: This scope fixes starter visibility and its acceptance contract only. It does not attest backend, model, identity or transaction capabilities.
